dish.title: Thai Fish Cakes with Cucumber Relish
dish.description: Springy, curry-red Thai fish cakes of ground white fish, shrimp-paste-free red curry paste, fish sauce, lime, and sliced green beans, pan-fried until crisp at the edges and served with a sweet-sour cucumber-shallot relish and jasmine rice. No peanuts, no shellfish.

recipe_version.title: Thai Fish Cakes with Cucumber Relish
recipe_version.description: Springy, curry-red Thai fish cakes of ground white fish, shrimp-paste-free red curry paste, fish sauce, lime, and sliced green beans, pan-fried until crisp at the edges and served with a sweet-sour cucumber-shallot relish and jasmine rice. No peanuts, no shellfish.

ingredients.name: jasmine rice
ingredients.preparation: rinsed until the water runs mostly clear

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: 2 cups for the rice, 2 tbsp warm water for the relish brine

ingredients.name: white fish fillets
ingredients.display_name: skinless firm white fish fillets (cod, haddock, or pollock)
ingredients.note: boneless; keep very cold. Finfish allergen.

ingredients.name: red curry paste
ingredients.note: REQUIRED shellfish-free paste: the label must list no shrimp, shrimp paste (kapi), krill, or other shellfish, and no soy or wheat. Many imported Thai red curry pastes contain shrimp paste; those are out of contract. Read the label.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.note: REQUIRED: label lists fish (anchovy), salt, and sugar/water only; no shrimp or other shellfish. Finfish allergen.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.note: binds the fish paste; egg allergen; HH001 allows eggs

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: 1 tsp in the fish paste, 3 tbsp (9 tsp) in the relish brine

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: zest into the fish paste; cut the zested lime into wedges for serving

ingredients.name: makrut lime leaves
ingredients.note: classic perfume; Asian grocers and some supermarkets (fresh or frozen). The lime zest carries the citrus note without them.
ingredients.preparation: center rib removed, sliced into very thin threads

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.note: about 3/4 cup sliced; stands in for Thai long beans

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.display_name: neutral high-heat oil (canola or avocado; not peanut oil)
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying in 2 batches, plus a little for your hands

ingredients.name: red chile
ingredients.display_name: fresh red chile (Fresno or red jalapeno)
ingredients.note: seed it for a milder relish

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.note: leaves and tender stems; for the relish and the plate

steps.title: Start the rice and prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice, put it in a medium saucepan with 2 cups water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce to low, and cook 15 minutes; turn off the heat and let it rest, covered, 10 minutes. It needs no attention after the first few minutes. Meanwhile, cut the fish into 1-inch chunks and pat dry; keep it cold. Slice the green beans into thin rounds. Zest the lime, then cut it into wedges. Remove the ribs from the lime leaves (if using) and slice into thin threads. Quarter and thinly slice the cucumber; slice the shallot and chile. Read the curry paste and fish sauce labels: no shrimp, shrimp paste, or other shellfish. HARD CONTRACT: no peanuts or other nuts on the relish; no shellfish anywhere.

steps.title: Make the cucumber relish
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk the rice vinegar, 3 tbsp sugar, the salt, and 2 tbsp warm water until the sugar and salt dissolve. Add the cucumber, shallot, and chile, and toss. Set aside; it improves as it sits. Stir in a few cilantro leaves right before serving.

steps.title: Make the fish paste
steps.body: In a food processor, combine the cold fish, curry paste, fish sauce, egg, and 1 tsp sugar. Pulse to break up, then process until it forms a thick, sticky, springy paste, about 1 minute, scraping down once. Scrape into a bowl and fold in the green beans, lime zest, and lime-leaf threads. With a wet hand, scoop and slap the paste against the side of the bowl for 1 minute; this gives the cakes their bouncy texture.

steps.title: Shape the cakes
steps.body: Lightly oil your hands. Shape the paste into 16 flat patties about 2 1/2 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick, setting them on an oiled plate or parchment.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.body: Heat 1/4 cup oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high until it shimmers. Fry 8 cakes until puffed and deep golden-brown with crisp, lacy edges, 2 to 3 minutes per side; they are done when they are opaque and springy in the center (145 F). Drain on paper towels. Repeat with the remaining oil and cakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Plate the fish cakes with rice, spoon the relish and some of its brine alongside, scatter with cilantro, and add lime wedges. No peanuts; no sweet chili sauce needed. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15 (rice goes on at minute 0 and cooks 15 + rests 10 unattended, ready by minute 25). Cook 28 = 2 relish + 4 fish paste + 6 shape 16 cakes + 14 pan-fry in 2 batches + 2 plate.
recipe_version.heat: High to boil the rice, then low; medium-high skillet for shallow-frying. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Cakes puffed, deep golden with crisp edges, opaque and springy in the center (145 F). Rice tender and fluffy. Relish crisp, sweet-sour, and lightly hot. kitchen_tested is false.

allergen_notes: Finfish covers the white fish and the anchovy fish sauce.
Egg covers the egg binder in the fish paste.
Shellfish is absent by contract: the red curry paste must have no shrimp, shrimp paste, or krill, and the fish sauce no shrimp.
No soy or wheat: the required curry paste spec excludes them. No milk, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, or shellfish in the written ingredients.
